blocks.text: Service Connector is an application that communicates with the Zscaler ITDR Admin Portal and sends events and audit logs to the Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) solution. You can integrate a Service Connector with one or multiple SIEM solutions.
Service Connectors provide the following benefits and enable you to:

blocks.item: Forward the events recorded by Zscaler ITDR to one or more SIEM solutions for real-time analysis of the log data in a centralized view.
Leverage built-in Service Connectors or configure your own Service Connectors by using the executables provided in the ITDR Admin Portal.

blocks.text: By default, Service Connectors are automatically configured in the ITDR Admin Portal. These Service Connectors are always running and cannot be edited or deleted.
On the Service Connectors page (Orchestrate > Service Connectors), you can view a list of all configured Service Connectors. For each Service Connector, you can see:

blocks.item: Name: The name of the Service Connector.
Version: The current version of the Service Connector.
Syslog Receiver Source: The name of the syslog receiver type that is configured.
Syslog Receiver Allowed IPs: The IP addresses to allow inbound connections from a configured syslog receiver.
